preview.text: Canterbury plays Northern Districts in a one-day match at Hagley Oval, where the usual first-innings score in the 17 recorded one-day matches is 254. Northern Districts won the toss and chose to bat first. The forecast for the next 8 hours is up to a 25 per cent chance of rain and about 25 degrees.

summary.text: Robert ODonnell scored 72 runs off 80 balls as ND finished their innings at 261-7, supported by Michael Rae who took 3 for 45. Canterbury chased the target to reach 264-6 and win by 4 wickets, led by Cole McConchie with 103 runs off 103 balls while Tim Pringle claimed 2 for 32.
